properties.title: Short authorization cache
properties.body: Cache access decisions for 15 seconds. A short lifetime limits how long revoked permissions remain usable.

properties.title: One database owner for shared project memory
properties.body: Claude Code and Cursor connect through separate proxies to one owning server. The server serializes writes to the shared project database.

properties.title: Keep project knowledge on this machine
properties.body: Confidential source code and customer notes must stay local. Search works without an API key or a network connection after dependencies are installed.

properties.title: Historical authorization cache proposal
properties.body: The old proposal allowed cached permissions for 30 minutes. That proposal is superseded by the short authorization cache decision.

properties.title: Permisos del proyecto
properties.body: Los permisos revocados dejan de funcionar después de 15 segundos. La caché es local.

properties.title: Session rollout exception
properties.body: Background: session rollout requires coordination with callers.
properties.tail: The decisive exception: service accounts must reauthenticate immediately after signing-key rotation.

properties.title: Verify revoked permissions
properties.body: Confirm access is denied after cache expiry. Acceptance: revoked access stops within 15 seconds.

properties.title: Document export behavior
properties.body: Explain where a local report is saved.

properties.title: Open the local settings page
properties.body: The settings page was verified already.
